body.purpose: Quiet supporting copy and interface text.

label.purpose: Navigation, case labels, tags, and timestamps.

motion.name: ease-out
motion.purpose: Menus, buttons, and short interface transitions.

components.name: Signal Button
components.description: Primary contact action on cobalt or ink fields.
components.css: .ds-button-signal { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; gap:18px; min-height:52px; padding:14px 22px; border:2px solid transparent; border-radius:999px; background:var(--signal); color:var(--ink); font:400 .74rem/1 var(--font-mono); letter-spacing:.03em; text-decoration:none; transition:background-color 180ms ease; } .ds-button-signal:hover { background:var(--sunflower); } .ds-button-signal:focus-visible { outline:3px solid var(--sunflower); outline-offset:4px; }

components.name: Outline Button
components.description: Secondary action that inherits its section color.
components.css: .ds-button-outline { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; gap:18px; min-height:52px; padding:14px 22px; border:2px solid currentColor; border-radius:999px; background:transparent; color:inherit; font:400 .74rem/1 var(--font-mono); letter-spacing:.03em; text-decoration:none; } .ds-button-outline:hover { background:var(--paper); color:var(--cobalt); } .ds-button-outline:focus-visible { outline:3px solid var(--sunflower); outline-offset:4px; }

components.name: Skill Chip
components.description: Non-interactive skill label with restrained pointer feedback.
components.css: .ds-skill-chip { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; min-height:44px; padding:9px 16px; border:1px solid currentColor; border-radius:999px; color:inherit; font-family:var(--font-body); line-height:1; transition:transform 180ms cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1); } .ds-skill-chip:hover { transform:rotate(-1.5deg) scale(1.045); }

components.name: Navigation Link
components.description: Compact mono label with a short drawn underline.
components.css: .ds-nav-link { position:relative; color:inherit; font:400 .72rem/1.2 var(--font-mono); letter-spacing:.03em; text-decoration:none; } .ds-nav-link::after { position:absolute; right:0; bottom:-5px; left:0; height:2px; content:''; background:currentColor; transform:scaleX(0); transform-origin:100% 50%; transition:transform 220ms cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1); } .ds-nav-link:hover::after, .ds-nav-link:focus-visible::after { transform:scaleX(1); transform-origin:0 50%; }

components.name: Project Panel
components.description: Full-bleed project summary used in the signature horizontal reel.
components.css: .ds-project-panel { display:flex; width:min(74vw,960px); min-height:520px; flex-direction:column; justify-content:space-between; padding:48px; border:2px solid var(--ink); border-radius:12px; background:var(--ink); color:var(--paper); text-align:left; } .ds-project-panel strong { max-width:11ch; font:600 clamp(3rem,6vw,5.5rem)/.86 var(--font-display); letter-spacing:-.035em; } .ds-project-panel span, .ds-project-panel small { font:400 .72rem/1.3 var(--font-mono); letter-spacing:.03em; } .ds-project-panel:focus-visible { outline:3px solid var(--sunflower); outline-offset:4px; }

narrative.overview: The system feels like a crisply registered screenprint brought to life: decisive flat color, blunt typography, and movement with a clear start and stop. It rejects sci-fi dashboards, paper dossiers, and generic SaaS landing pages.
keyCharacteristics: Full-width flat color fields with no gradients or decorative shadows.
Large display type constrained to a 6rem ceiling.
One horizontal, cursor-aware Project Reel on desktop with a vertical fallback.
Compact, evidence-led copy with generous breathing room.

rules.name: The One-Field Rule
rules.body: Every section uses exactly one solid background; structure comes from contrast and type scale.

rules.name: The Sunflower Ration
rules.body: Sunflower marks information in small doses and never competes with cobalt or signal orange.

rules.name: The Wide-Jump Rule
rules.body: Commit to clear scale changes instead of filling the hierarchy with indistinct middle sizes.

rules.name: The Flat Means Flat Rule
rules.body: If an element needs a soft shadow to separate from its field, fix the color, spacing, or border instead.

dos: Do use exactly one of paper, ink, cobalt, or signal orange as each section background.
Do lead with the Online Gambling Ad Blocker as the strongest evidence.
Do make reduced-motion behavior a structural fallback.
donts: Don't use sci-fi dashboards, neon developer terminals, or generic SaaS interfaces.
Don't use gradients, soft shadows, glassmorphism, or decorative grid backgrounds.
Don't place cursor-follow effects or horizontal scrolling outside the Project Reel.
